findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 10 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 20 questions numbered 1-20; by section: 10.1 10, 10.2 5, 10.3 5.

20 five-mark questions: quadratic equations in one ratio (with an impossible root rejected), equations reduced by identities and factorisation, a homogeneous equation, equations needing squaring with every root checked (extraneous roots rejected), graphical solutions with table of values, sign test and symmetry (including one confirmed exactly), subtended angles with the tan^-1 difference formula (exact height from a quadratic), two angles of elevation and projectile range problems, all with new data. Book corrections followed (4pi/3 + 2n pi family, x = 0 not a root of cos x = x/8, exact height in surd form). Every step was checked by computation (check10.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
